directory_owned_snapshot.tagline: Friendly lawns on the quiet edge of Sampleton
directory_owned_snapshot.play_schedule:
Wednesday 8:00am–11:00am — Golf Croquet
Saturday 1:00pm–4:00pm — Golf Croquet
Sunday 8:00am–11:00am — Association / Ricochet
directory_owned_snapshot.come_and_try: Wear flat, enclosed shoes, sunscreen and a broad-brimmed hat. We provide mallets and a friendly member to show you the ropes for your first visit.
directory_owned_snapshot.fees:
Annual membership: $220 (or four quarterly instalments of $55)
Green fees: $5 a visit (covers lawn upkeep and equipment)
Junior membership (under 18): $60 (half price, mallets provided)
